 CREMONA, ITALY - OCTOBER 14: Luca Koleosho of Italy in action during the UEFA Euro U21 Qualification match between Italy and Armenia at Stadio Giovanni Zini on October 14, 2025 in Cremona, Italy. (Photo by Marco M. Mantovani/Getty Images) November 1, 2026 7 Paris FC will be without winger Luca Koleosho as they prepare to host AS Monaco at the Stade Jean Bouin on Sunday afternoon.
 Koleosho, an Italy international who has been in fine form in recent weeks, is a big miss for Liam Rosenior. It is expected that former FC Nantes winger Moses Simon will be the one to replace him on the left wing. He is also without two other starters: Nhoa Sangiu and Adama Camara. The absence of the latter, who has often started at right back for Paris FC, could see Rudi Matondo given a chance to impress in a defensive position.
 By and large, however, this is a very settled side and it is expected that the only changes made to his side will be those that have been forced.
 Paris FC likely line-up v Monaco
 Kevin Trapp; Hamari Traoré, Diego Coppola, Samir Chergui, Rudi Matondo; Pierre Lees-Melou, Maxime Lopez; Moses Simon, Pablo Pagis, Ilan Kebbal; Lassine Sinayoko. (L’Éq)
